decision: complete the empirical reconstruction for every execution outside the approved excluded arms

approved_excluded_arms.reason: No licensed, versioned animal trajectory cohort is available for animal-to-human pretraining.
The current scope does not require condition-variant reproduction; aligned temperature and precipitation are unavailable. Existing successful variants remain supplemental evidence.
Endpoint-prior bridges are an expert-assisted extension and are outside the current core reproduction.

required_rule: Every frozen execution whose arm_id is not approved_excluded must succeed on the registered DSDE 20% pilot.
scope_notes: Approved exclusions preserve implementation and contract coverage; they change only the empirical reproduction requirement.
Scientific verdicts remain exploratory and are not implied by task completion.
